film.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
S: Twisted Robin Hood king prawn cocktail
Forbes calls Jordan a twisted Robin Hood

Drop the prawns into simmering salted water for 2 minutes until just pink, then into iced water. Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon into Marie Rose sauce. Fill 4 chilled glasses with lettuce and avocado. Hang the prawns over the rim, spoon over the sauce and dust with paprika.
16 raw king prawns, peeled with tails on@Seafood
Aunt Emma's smoked salmon blini with caviar
Aunt Emma holds the Swiss money

Whisk the flours, baking powder and a pinch of salt with the milk, egg and half the butter. Brush a frying pan with butter and cook tablespoons of batter until bubbles show, then flip. Top each blini with creme fraiche and a curl of salmon. Finish with a little caviar, dill and a squeeze of lemon.
M: Naomi's lobster thermidor with shoestring fries
Jordan throws lobsters at the FBI

Bake the fries at 220C until crisp while you make the sauce. Pull the lobster meat from the shells and tails, cut into chunks and keep the shells. Soften the shallot in the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and cream and simmer until thick. Stir in the mustard, tarragon, half the cheese and the lobster, then pile back into the shells. Scatter with the rest of the cheese and grill until bubbling and golden, then serve with the fries and lemon.
Steve Madden IPO steak au poivre with frites

Bake the chips at 220C until golden. Press the pepper into both sides of the steaks and season with salt. Sear in the oil and butter over high heat, 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium rare, then rest. Pour the cognac into the pan and let it bubble off, then add the stock and cream and boil until it coats a spoon. Serve the steaks with the sauce, frites and watercress.
W: Jordan calls the Lemmons the holy grail

Whisk the lemon zest and juice, 200g sugar, 6 yolks and cornflour in a pan over low heat until thick. Take off the heat, whisk in the butter, pour into the tart case and chill until set. Whisk the whites with the cream of tartar to soft peaks, then add the rest of the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Pile the meringue over the curd and bake at 200C until golden at the tips. Cool for 10 minutes before slicing.

K: Mark Hanna's Absolut martini, straight up
Stir the vodka and vermouth with ice in a jug for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into 4 chilled martini glasses and twist a strip of lemon peel over each.
film.T: Money talks and bullshit takes the bus.
film.D: A Long Island penny-stock broker builds Stratton Oakmont into a machine for money, drugs and excess, with the FBI one step behind.
film.P: Serve the lobster when Jordan throws two at the FBI agents.
